svg.title: Paired confidence intervals and theoretical selection coverage
svg.desc: The same 24 samples produce z, t, and narrower-selected intervals. Lower panel shows exact-rule coverage computed by numerical quadrature.
svg.text: Normal population: mean 500 ml, SD 8 ml; n=16; 95% nominal; 24 independent samples.
Theory for the whole selection rule; nominal confidence remains 95%
Sample size n; the blue curve is theory, not the finite-sample count above.
